header: Only certified staff on certified shifts
bodytext:
Each qualification is stored with its expiry date: a first-aid certificate, a forklift licence, a food-safety course or the right to close alone. Only someone who holds the required qualification can fill a shift that needs it. If the planner refuses someone, it shows the reason.

The holder and their manager get a notice 30 days before a certificate expires. Shifts stay within the rules because someone is told in time, not because of a report afterwards.
quote_text: We kept the certificates in a lever-arch file. After two months, the system found a forklift licence that had expired in February and had been planned 11 times since.
author: Ruth Amsler
